ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-30) — no quarterly DPS fact since
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2017-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-06-30..2017-03-31, 32 facts); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2019-03-31) is 2648 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2026 (2025-07-01..2026-06-30) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividend_yield.basis: FY2026 DPS (fy_fact, period ended 2026-06-30) — no quarterly DPS fact since
